articles.summary: Continues Canada's commitment to smallpox preparedness for the Canadian Armed Forces NEW YORK, Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - SIGA Technologies, Inc. (SIGA) (Nasdaq: SIGA), a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, today announced that Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC) has awarded SIGA a new contract for the procurement of oral TPOXX® (tecovirimat), an antiviral medication used to treat smallpox, on behalf of the Canadian Department of National Defence (CDND) through its Strategic Medical Countermeasures Program. The contract provides for the purchase of up to approximately $15 million by March 31, 2031, of which approximately $9 million represents firm commitments over the first three years of the contract and approximately $6 million is subject to option exercise by the CDND.
